opening.argument: The video presents a guided process for selling OneCoin for euros, beginning with an account, coin-fee, and trading-term checks. It requires a payment before selling, stating that "the account you need to pay for the payment first. It is only $1 to $10 to sell." The account interface also makes eligibility conditional on KYC-related approval. Alongside those payment and access requirements, OneCoin is described as an "$1K investor opportunity," and the speaker refers to "making this profit." Taken together, the demonstrated sale process and profit-oriented investment framing establish a payment-linked opportunity involving token purchase, appreciation, or dividends.
